name: Stegosaurus
description: The stegosaurus is a large, herbivorous dinosaur with a low, heavy body and distinctive rows of bony plates along its back. Its long tail ends in sharp spikes, which it uses for defense against predators. Though slow-moving, its powerful limbs and size make it a formidable presence in any environment.

actions.name: Trample
actions.description: The stegosaurus moves up to 2 units and tramples a medium or smaller creature that they end adjacent to, dealing physical damage and knocking the target prone. If the creature is already prone and fails to defend themselves against this attack, the damage is upgraded to a brutal critical. If this attack brings a creature to 0 health, they fall unconscious regardless of their lifeline roll.

actions.name: Tail Slam
actions.description: The stegosaurus lifts it's tail and slams it down on a creature, dealing physical damage.

actions.name: Tail Sweep
actions.description: The stegosaurus sweeps it's tail in a 2 unit cone, dealing physical damage and knocking any creature hit prone.

actions.name: Make Space
actions.description: When an adjacent medium or smaller creature fails to damage the stegosaurus after making a melee attack, the stegosaurus retaliates with it's tail and makes a shove attack.

traits.name: Thick Skin
traits.description: A stegosaurus benefits from having thick skin, causing the bleeding condition to end on a 1 or 2 damage roll and the ignited condition to end if 2 or more 1's or 2's are rolled on the damage dice.
